items.rationale: The failed indoor heating pipe falls under §2.4.3(a). Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.9 limit payment to pipe needed for the repair at the plain-copper rate, estimated at €15/m × 6.4 m if the full length is substantiated.
Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.9 cover necessary fittings at the standard copper equivalent, not the chrome premium. Case 40 supports about €10 per elbow × 4.
Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.9 allow standard copper elbows where needed to reconnect the affected run, but not fittings used solely for the upgrade. Case 40 supports about €20 per elbow × 5.
Under §§7.1.7(c) and 7.1.9, a necessary elbow is payable at the plain-copper equivalent. Case 40 supports about €20 for one.
Minor fixings used in the repair are covered under §§7.1.7(c) and 7.1.8(e). The calibrated gross allowance is €1.10 × 8.
Section 7.1.8(e) excludes materials whose dimensions do not match the documented repair; no 10 mm pipework is identified. If a repair use is established, allow about €5 per clamp × 4.
Necessary pipe supports are covered fixings under §7.1.7(c). The Case 40 calibration gives about €25 gross for four clamps.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers customary labour for the repair; §§7.1.5 and 7.1.9 exclude time attributable solely to the new equipment or upgrade. The calibrated gross total for 6.75 repair hours is €595.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers helper time needed for the repair, not time spent on elective additions under §7.1.9. The calibrated gross total for 5.75 repair hours is €418.
Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.9 limit re-insulation to the cost of the original rock-wool specification. Cases 18 and 40 support about €20 per piece × 6.
Under §§7.1.7(c) and 7.1.9, binding wire is allowable as a consumable for like-for-like rock-wool reinstatement. The calibrated price is €9.80/kg × 2 kg.
Section 7.1.9 excludes new installations with no pre-loss equivalent. The €95 figure is a conditional gross price for one sensor, not an allowance under this policy.
Section 7.1.9 excludes the valve because it was not present before the loss. The €130 figure is a conditional gross price for one valve, not an allowance under this policy.
Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.8(e) permit a lump sum for minor repair consumables, provided it does not duplicate other charges or fund the additions. The calibrated gross allowance is €36.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows one travel charge per contractor per invoice. This is the only such charge, so the calibrated gross allowance is €79.
Sections 5.2.1 and 7.1.7(a) cover disposal of pipe and insulation removed for the necessary repair. Cases 18 and 40 support €60 gross for one disposal charge.
Section 7.1.8(b) expressly excludes separate administrative and processing fees. The conditional figure is €20 gross for one fee.
